# Accessibility Checker

> Free WCAG 2.1 + 2.2 accessibility scanner. Scan a page or a whole site;
> Pro adds rendered scans, daily monitoring with score-drop alerts, and
> emailed reports. 14-day free trial.

- API: https://accessibility-checker.dry-hall-6a50.workers.dev
